heading: THE GREAT UNBUNDLING OF INTELLIGENCE (8 MINUTE READ)
blurb: Agent economics are pushing AI from frontier-by-default toward capability-level routing, where judgment, ranking, search, and verification use cheaper specialized systems. Frontier models may handle fewer but harder tasks as applications become intelligence compilers that recombine services efficiently.

heading: VINOD KHOSLA'S TWO MOATS FOR PERSONAL AI (1 MINUTE READ)
blurb: Personal AI may ultimately compete on two moats: trust and task completion. Vinod Khosla says users will stay loyal to companies they trust with sensitive data and products that reliably finish work, while Meta faces a trust disadvantage.
